description: This Java source file defines the DisplayActivity class for an Android app, managing UI fragments, full-screen mode, and broadcast receivers for image display and download status updates.

classes.name: DownloadStateReceiver
classes.description: Handles broadcast messages related to download states and updates UI accordingly.

classes.name: FragmentDisplayer
classes.description: Handles broadcast messages to display or zoom images by managing fragments.

methods.name: setFullScreen
methods.description: Configures the activity to be full-screen or not, adjusting UI flags and action bar visibility.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Responds to changes in the fragment back stack, adjusting full-screen mode when fragments are popped.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current full-screen state before activity is killed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, registers broadcast receivers, and manages initial fragment setup.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receivers and cleans up resources.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops background threads managed by PhotoManager.
